# Actions and navigation

From [the component index](../components.md). A prop with `?` is optional, and `= x` is its default. An indented line is the shape of a value the prop takes. In the examples, `children`, `transactions`, the icons and the handlers stand for the screen's own content, data and state.

## Button

```tsx
import { Button } from "@tuja/ui/components/button";
```

Every action and every link that looks like a button; `href` makes it a link.

Props (also `css`, and every attribute of `<button>`):

- `children?: ReactNode` — Visible label. Required unless `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` names an icon-only button.
- `hideLabelOnMobile?: boolean` — Below the `md` breakpoint, collapses to a square icon-only button and hides the label.
- `icon?: ReactNode` — Decorative leading icon. Rendered `aria-hidden`; never the accessible name.
- `trailing?: ReactNode` — Trailing content, such as a count, a note or a caret.
- `size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" = "md"` — Height scale via `controlSize`.
- `isActive?: boolean` — Toggles the active highlight.
- `look?: "primary" | "outline" | "ghost" | "bright" | "danger"` — Visual look. Omit for the default raised surface.
- `intent?: "danger"` — `"danger"` marks a secondary destructive action on an `outline` or `ghost` button, such as Delete in a bar of other actions: the label and the hover fill turn danger, and the button keeps the weight of the buttons beside it.
- `bleed?: "start" | "end"` — Lets a `ghost` button reach past its edge of the content, so that its label or glyph, not its padded box, lines up with the text above and below.
- `labelId?: string` — Id applied to the label span, e.g. to wire an external `aria-labelledby`.
- `aria-label?: string` — Accessible name for an icon-only button.
- `aria-labelledby?: string` — Id of the element naming an icon-only button — the alternative to `aria-label` when there are no `children`.
- `href?: string` — Destination. With it the button renders a link and takes `target`, `rel`, `download` and `linkComponent`.
- `loading?: boolean` — Shows a spinner, sets `aria-busy`, and blocks activation.
- `linkComponent?: LinkSlot` — Link Slot: renders the anchor for this button alone.

Example:

```tsx
function ButtonExample() {
  return (
    <div css={row.inline}>
      <Button look="ghost">Cancel</Button>
      <Button look="primary" type="submit" icon={<PlusIcon weight="bold" />}>
        Add
      </Button>
      <Button look="danger" size="sm" icon={<TrashIcon weight="bold" />}>
        Delete all data
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## MenuButton, MenuItem, MenuLabel

```tsx
import { MenuButton } from "@tuja/ui/components/menu-button";
import { MenuItem } from "@tuja/ui/components/menu-item";
import { MenuLabel } from "@tuja/ui/components/menu-label";
```

A button that opens a menu of commands, such as More with Rename and Delete.

### MenuButton

Props (also `css`):

- `children?: ReactNode` — The trigger's visible label, repeated at the top of the popup as its title.
- `buttonProps: Partial<ButtonFormProps>` — Props forwarded to the trigger `Button` (e.g. `icon`, `look`, `disabled`).
- `menuContent: ReactNode` — Content rendered into the expanded popup.
- `position?: "topRight" | "topLeft" | "bottomLeft" | "bottomRight" | "sheet" = "topRight"` — Which of the trigger's logical corners the menu expands from, or `"sheet"` to span the bar the trigger sits in.
- `disabled?: boolean` — Disable the menu trigger.
- `popupRole?: "menu" | "group" = "menu"` — ARIA role for the popup content.
- `open?: boolean` — Controlled open state. Requires `onOpenChange`.
- `onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void` — Called with the next state on every open or close.

### MenuItem

Props (also `css`, and every attribute of `<a>`):

- `children: ReactNode` — The item's label.
- `trailing?: ReactNode` — Muted text at the end of the row, such as the date a choice stands for.
- `current?: boolean = false` — Marks the item as the value in force, with `aria-current`, and fills it.
- `intent?: "danger"` — `"danger"` marks an action that destroys something: the label and the hover fill turn danger, as on a `ghost` `Button` with `intent="danger"`.
- `size?: "sm" | "md" = "md"` — Row height. `"md"` matches a `md` control; `"sm"` is for a long menu of many commands.
- `href?: string` — Renders the item as a plain `<a>` that the browser follows itself.

### MenuLabel

Props: `css`, and every attribute of `<div>`.

Example:

```tsx
function MenuButtonExample() {
  return (
    <MenuButton
      buttonProps={{
        icon: <DotsThreeIcon weight="bold" />,
        look: "ghost",
        size: "sm",
      }}
      menuContent={
        <div css={stack.rows}>
          <MenuItem onClick={close}>Rename</MenuItem>
          <MenuItem intent="danger" onClick={close}>
            Delete
          </MenuItem>
        </div>
      }
    >
      More
    </MenuButton>
  );
}
```

## NavList, NavGroup, NavLink

```tsx
import { NavList } from "@tuja/ui/components/nav-list";
import { NavGroup } from "@tuja/ui/components/nav-group";
import { NavLink } from "@tuja/ui/components/nav-link";
```

The links between the pages of one place, such as settings sections in a sidebar or the `secondary` of a `TabView`.

### NavList

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — The rows: each a `NavLink`, or a `NavGroup` of them, which is a section.
- `linkComponent?: ComponentType<NavListLinkProps> = PlainAnchor` — The component that renders every link in the list, groups included, such as a router's link.

### NavGroup

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — The rows: each a `NavLink`, or a `NavGroup` one level down.
- `label?: ReactNode` — The group's name. It names the group for a screen reader too.
- `icon?: ReactNode` — An icon at the start of the row of a group in a group, in the muted colour.
- `current?: boolean = false` — Marks the group in a group that holds the page being read.

### NavLink

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — The link's name, on one line.
- `href: string` — Where the link goes.
- `current?: boolean = false` — Marks the page being read.
- `icon?: ReactNode` — An icon at the start of the row, in the muted colour.
- `trailing?: ReactNode` — Something at the end of the row, in the muted colour at caption size, as a `TabView` sidebar row shows its `count`: a count, a `Badge` such as "Today", or a `StatusDot`.

Example:

```tsx
function NavListExample() {
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Reports">
      <NavList>
        <NavGroup label="November">
          <NavLink href="/reports/10" current>
            10 November
          </NavLink>
          <NavLink href="/reports/9">9 November</NavLink>
        </NavGroup>
      </NavList>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

## Anchor

```tsx
import { Anchor } from "@tuja/ui/components/anchor";
```

A text link inside a sentence, or standing alone.

Props (also `css`, and every attribute of `<a>`):

- `href: string` — Destination.
- `newTabLabel: string` — Screen-reader text after a link with `target="_blank"`, such as "(opens in new tab)".
- `indicateExternal?: boolean = true` — Show the external-link icon and `newTabLabel` when `target="_blank"`.
- `tone?: "default" | "muted" = "default"` — `"default"` stands out from the text around it: full colour and semibold.
- `standalone?: boolean = false` — The link stands on its own, outside a sentence.
- `linkComponent?: ComponentType<AnchorLinkProps> = PlainAnchor` — Link Slot — renders the anchor.

## Breadcrumb

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from "@tuja/ui/components/breadcrumb";
```

The trail of pages above the current one.

Props (also `css`):

- `items: ReadonlyArray<BreadcrumbItem>` — The trail, root first.
  - `BreadcrumbItem { label: string; href?: string }`
- `label: string` — Accessible name for the `<nav>` landmark.
- `separator?: ReactNode` — Separator between crumbs, rendered `aria-hidden`.
- `linkComponent?: ComponentType<BreadcrumbLinkProps> = BreadcrumbAnchor` — Link Slot — renders every navigable crumb.

Example:

```tsx
function BreadcrumbExample() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb
      label="Breadcrumb"
      items={[{ label: "Settings", href: "/settings" }, { label: "Rules" }]}
    />
  );
}
```

## Pager

```tsx
import { Pager } from "@tuja/ui/components/pager";
```

Links to the previous and next page at the end of a page in a sequence.

Props (also `css`):

- `aria-label: string` — Accessible name for the `<nav>` landmark.
- `previous?: PagerPage` — The page before this one.
  - `PagerPage { href: string; label: string; title: string }`
- `next?: PagerPage` — The page after this one.
  - `PagerPage { href: string; label: string; title: string }`
- `linkComponent?: LinkSlot` — Link Slot: renders each anchor.

## ExternalLinkIndicator

```tsx
import { ExternalLinkIndicator } from "@tuja/ui/components/external-link-indicator";
```

The icon and screen-reader text for a custom link that opens in a new tab.

Props (also `css`):

- `label: string` — Screen-reader text that says the link opens in a new tab, such as "(opens in new tab)".
